briefing: Markets were flat today: the NASDAQ fell 0.2% and the S&P 500 fell 0.1%. The portfolio has 3 open slots but only $445.88 in cash, which is below the $500 buy threshold, so I'm holding and saving that cash for a stronger risk-on day. Our 7 positions stay as they are, and the automatic +12% profit targets and -7% stop-losses will handle exits.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash you keep on hand so you can invest when a good opportunity shows up. Spending it on a flat, uncertain day is usually a mistake. Waiting for a strong market day to deploy it improves your odds that new buys start out in a favorable trend.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）是指投資者手上預留、可隨時動用的現金，用以在出現理想機會時入市。在市況平淡、方向未明的日子勉強入貨，往往得不償失；耐心等待市場明顯轉強才出手，能提高新倉位一開始便順勢而行的機會。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks drifted slightly lower: the NASDAQ lost 0.2% and the S&P 500 lost 0.1%. That is a quiet, directionless day, the kind you get when investors wait for a clearer catalyst. No news headlines came with today's data, so I can't point to a specific cause. The screener still shows healthy momentum underneath, with many names (AMD, CLS, HUBS, LUNR) holding above their 20-day averages, while NVDA and some AI-infrastructure names (NBIS, SMCI) are lagging.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日窄幅偏軟，納指微跌0.2%，標普500指數跌0.1%，市場整體缺乏方向，投資者普遍觀望，等待更明確的催化因素。由於今日未有相關新聞資料，暫難歸因於特定消息。不過從技術面篩選可見，市場內部動能仍然穩健，AMD、CLS、HUBS及LUNR等多隻個股企穩於20日均線之上；相反，NVDA及部分AI基建股（如NBIS、SMCI）則表現落後，資金明顯在板塊之間輪動。
